states.offline: Account information is offline. Safe draft fields remain available in this browser.
states.stale: The displayed account information may be out of date. Reconnect and refresh before reviewing it.
states.expired: Your review session expired. Return to sign-in; no session or credential was kept.
states.failure: Account information could not be refreshed. No changes were made, and safe recovery remains available.

signIn.title: Sign in to your account
signIn.summary: Access subscriptions, devices, downloads, and support with your Liiiraa Boost identity.
signIn.emailHint: Use the email linked to your account.
signIn.security: Your credentials are sent only over a secure connection and never appear in diagnostics.
signIn.invalidEmail: Enter a complete email address, such as player@example.com.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.summary: Create your Liiiraa Boost identity to access the app, devices, and benefits.
signUp.nameHint: The name displayed on your account.
signUp.emailHint: Use an email you can access.
signUp.passwordHint: 10+ characters with uppercase, lowercase, and a number.
signUp.consentLabel: I have read and accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
signUp.security: By continuing, you accept the terms and protect the account with the available methods.
signUp.invalidName: Enter a name with at least 2 characters.
signUp.invalidEmail: Enter a complete email address, such as player@example.com.
signUp.invalidPassword: Use at least 10 characters with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, and number.

onboarding.title: Set up your Liiiraa Boost experience
onboarding.summary: Configure your account, choose a plan, and move PC analysis to the Windows app.
onboarding.identityTitle: Sign in or create your account
onboarding.identityBody: Use one account to keep your subscription, device, downloads, and support together.
onboarding.verifyTitle: Verify your email and protect access
onboarding.verifyBody: After verification, prepare a passkey or MFA and keep your recovery methods safe.
onboarding.planBody: Essential is free and keeps PC analysis, safe recommendations, history, and restoration. Premium unlocks applicable optimizations, Competitive Mode, and priority support.
onboarding.essentialDetail: Analyze your PC, understand recommendations, and preserve history and restoration without a charge.
onboarding.premiumDetail: Apply compatible optimizations, use Competitive Mode, and receive support within 24 hours.
onboarding.premiumPayment: Payment is requested only for Premium. Price, taxes, and renewal are shown before confirmation; the first subscription includes a full refund within seven days.
onboarding.essentialPayment: Essential does not ask for a card or create a charge. You can continue directly to the download.
onboarding.downloadBody: Download the public stable release. The installer and updates must be signed and verified before any distribution.
onboarding.activateBody: First activation links a protected identity to one PC. Raw HWID is never displayed or stored.
onboarding.manageBody: After activation, keep track of your plan, device, downloads, and support here.
onboarding.browserBoundary: This page does not inspect hardware, drivers, processes, or games. Deep analysis runs locally in the Windows app.
onboarding.localPrivacy: PC details stay local by default. Only a summary you choose can be shared with explicit consent.

overview.title: Account overview
overview.summary: Review the next account responsibilities from one focused workspace.
overview.nextBody: Review the public profile and planned security methods before moving into subscription or device responsibilities.
overview.localPreviewBody: Safe information is available for you to continue.
overview.noAuthorityBody: There are no account changes to show yet.
overview.emptyBody: There are no billing, device, session, or support records to review. Start with Profile or Support to continue safely.
overview.recommendedBody: Add Windows Hello as your quickest protected way back into this account.
overview.continuityBody: Optimization history and restoration remain accessible even if Premium expires or this PC is offline.
overview.degradedBody: Live account details could not be refreshed. The last coherent plan, PC, and security summary remains visible below.

profile.title: Profile
profile.summary: Review how your name and language appear on the account.
profile.nameDescription: Shown as the public name on your account. Maximum 80 characters.
profile.limitations: Check the name and language before confirming. If saving is unavailable, no account data is changed.

security.title: Security
security.summary: Protect access with verified email, a passkey, MFA, and recovery methods.
security.emptyAlerts: There are no security alerts to review.
security.sessionDetail: Edge on Windows 11 · last seen 2026-01-15 12:00 UTC
security.recoveryDetail: Recovery codes are shown once, after secure confirmation.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.summary: Review Premium terms, billing timing, cancellation, refunds, and device rules.
subscription.essentialPlan: Essential free: PC analysis, recommendations, history, and restoration — without applying optimizations.
subscription.premiumBenefits: Premium: applies compatible optimizations, unlocks Competitive Mode, and includes priority support.
subscription.renewal: Renews on the selected cycle; card supports monthly and annual billing, Pix supports annual billing in Brazil, and boleto is unavailable at launch
subscription.taxes: Applicable taxes are shown before confirmation
subscription.cancellation: Cancel at any time and keep access through the paid cycle
subscription.refunds: Full refund within seven days of the first subscription
subscription.deviceRules: One active PC; transfer or reset every 30 days, with legitimate exceptions through support
subscription.expirationEffects: Premium works offline for 30 days and then returns to Free; history and restoration remain available
subscription.paymentMethods: Card for monthly and annual billing; Pix for annual billing in Brazil. Boleto is unavailable at launch.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.summary: Review charges, payment method, billing period, and the status of each invoice.
invoices.caption: Invoice history
invoices.empty: You do not have any invoices yet. The Essential plan never creates a charge.
invoices.paymentMethods: Accepted at launch: card for monthly or annual billing and Pix for annual billing in Brazil.
invoices.billingHelp: Report an unrecognized charge to support before making another payment attempt.

device.title: Device
device.summary: Review the current device details and the 30-day replacement cooldown.
device.label: My primary PC
device.detail: Windows 11 · protected identity · raw HWID is never stored
device.cooldown: You can transfer or reset the active PC every 30 days. Reinstalls and minor upgrades do not consume a reset; major hardware changes may require a new activation.
device.motherboard: A motherboard replacement or significant hardware change can create a new protected identity and require reactivation.
device.supportException: For hardware failure, repair, or a legitimate replacement, support can review an exception before 30 days.
device.offlineGrace: Premium remains validated offline for up to 30 days; the app then returns to Essential until it reconnects.
device.permanentAccess: History, evidence, and restoration remain available on Essential, while offline, or after expiration.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.summary: Stable releases remain public and never require an account.
downloads.boundary: This link opens the public release surface. No session, account context, or form data crosses origins.
downloads.stableChannel: Stable: recommended for everyone and updated automatically after validation and signing.
downloads.betaChannel: Beta: optional early access with a straightforward return to the stable channel.
downloads.updates: The app checks signed manifests and installs updates only after integrity is confirmed.

privacy.title: Privacy center
privacy.summary: Control each available optional use of your data independently and review your data rights before anything leaves this account.
privacy.consentSummary: Telemetry, support diagnostics, and personalized AI remain separate. One choice never enables another.
privacy.rightsSummary: Open a request to understand its scope, consequences, exceptions, and identity review. You can cancel before confirmation.
privacy.purpose: Review one specific consent or data-rights request without granting authority to change remote account data.
privacy.retention: Request details remain only for the current review and are cleared when you leave it.
privacy.sharing: Nothing is uploaded, sent, or shared.
privacy.revocation: Cancel at any time. The review closes and no account data changes.
privacy.telemetry: Telemetry and diagnostic summaries are off by default and can be sent only with specific, revocable consent.

consents.title: Optional telemetry
consents.purpose: Understand product stability and use through proportionate, aggregate measurements tied to a purpose explained before collection.
consents.dataClasses: Only the classes shown in the consent choice; never personal content, support diagnostics, or cross-site activity by default.
consents.retention: Disabled now. Before activation, the interface will state a limited period and the policy will record the applicable duration.
consents.sharing: No optional data is shared while telemetry is disabled; future processors must be identified before consent is requested.
history: 2026-08-03 — Off by default; no optional telemetry was sent.
consents.revocationEffect: You can refuse or withdraw without losing safety, restoration, or documentation. Withdrawal stops new collection and explains what happens to earlier data.

consents.title: Diagnostics sent to support
consents.purpose: Investigate one support request using only the package that you review and authorize for that specific case.
consents.dataClasses: Technical fields visible in the package review, with secrets, credentials, and unrelated information excluded before sending.
consents.retention: No diagnostics are sent now. The case period and related deletion timing will appear before any real submission.
consents.sharing: Only people and processors needed for the authorized case, all still subject to identification before remote support launches.
history: 2026-08-03 — Off by default; no diagnostic package was authorized.
consents.revocationEffect: Canceling before submission discards the package. After submission, withdrawal stops new access and provides the applicable deletion path.

consents.title: Personalized AI
consents.purpose: Use context you choose to provide personalized guidance without turning local diagnostics into hidden training or processing.
consents.dataClasses: Only questions and context shown in the consent screen; diagnostics, history, and identity stay excluded until explicitly selected.
consents.retention: Disabled now. Periods for prompts, responses, and context will be stated before any cloud processing takes place.
consents.sharing: No provider receives data while personalized AI is disabled; every future processor and purpose will be disclosed before sending.
history: 2026-08-03 — Off by default; no prompt or account context was sent.
consents.revocationEffect: Withdrawal stops new submissions and future personalization. The interface will explain how to delete earlier context subject to applicable duties.

rights.title: Access and export
rights.scope: Account profile, security methods, subscription records, linked-device references, consent history, and support-case metadata available to the future account authority.
rights.consequences: Preparing an export does not change or delete data. The future authority would verify identity before exposing a portable copy.
rights.retentionExceptions: Secrets, recovery material, other people's data, and security details that would create risk are excluded. Legally protected records may be described without exposing restricted content.
rights.review: Review the included categories, portable format, delivery channel, identity check, and any lawful limitation before confirmation.
rights.cancellation: Cancel before confirmation to discard this review. No export is created or delivered.

rights.title: Correct account data
rights.scope: Profile and account data you identify as incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated, together with evidence needed to review the correction.
rights.consequences: A confirmed correction could update future account use while preserving a trace of the request and its outcome.
rights.retentionExceptions: Immutable billing, security, fraud-prevention, and audit records are not silently rewritten; an allowed correction is linked to the original record.
rights.review: Compare the current value, proposed value, reason, supporting evidence, and identity check before confirmation.
rights.cancellation: Cancel before confirmation to discard the proposed value and supporting review. No account field changes.

rights.title: Delete account data
rights.scope: The future account and optional cloud data associated with it. Local PC data remains under your control on that PC.
rights.consequences: Deletion could remove account access, device and license links, cloud consent history, and support records. Public safety, recovery, and documentation remain available.
rights.retentionExceptions: Billing, security, fraud-prevention, dispute, and audit records may be retained or restricted only for a documented legal duty and its applicable period.
rights.review: Review affected services, local-versus-cloud boundaries, active obligations, identity verification, and the final irreversible consequence before confirmation.
rights.cancellation: Cancel before confirmation to leave the account and all remote records unchanged.

support.title: Support
support.summary: Prepare a support request and review its contents before anything is sent.
support.purpose: Prepare a support request for explicit review.
support.retention: The draft is discarded if you leave before confirmation.
support.sharing: No diagnostic, attachment, email, or account record is shared.
support.revocation: Cancel the review at any point; nothing has been submitted.
support.noUpload: Diagnostics can be attached only with explicit consent for this request.
support.sensitiveReview: Remove credentials, payment data, recovery codes, and unrelated personal information before any future submission.
support.standardResponse: Essential: first response within 72 business hours.
support.premiumResponse: Premium: priority first response within 24 business hours.
support.exceptionPath: Hardware failure or a legitimate device lockout can be reviewed by support, including during the 30-day interval.
